title: MIRAGE: Multi-model Interface for Reviewing and Auditing Generative Text-to-Image AI

bias_targets.methodology: User-driven auditing utilizing a multi-model side-by-side comparison interface (MIRAGE) to visually inspect and self-report text-to-image outputs for stereotypes, such as observing correlations between darker skin tones and manual labor occupations.

User-driven visual auditing through side-by-side comparison of multiple text-to-image models to identify Western-centric defaults in generated artifacts, such as comparing generated dinner party settings to non-Western cultural norms.
User-driven qualitative auditing of text-to-image generations to identify underrepresentation and stereotyping of genders in high-status occupational roles (e.g., doctors, lawyers, judges).
